Count what each date of a rebuilt series rests on, before building it

Source: R/previewBackfillSupport.R
previewBackfillSupport.Rd

Returns the support table that backfillColonySnapshots reports for the same dates, without the gene drop, so the counts are there in a moment and a start year can be chosen knowingly before minutes of analysis are spent (issue #170). The Genetic-Health Trends tab shows this same table before its "Build earlier snapshots" button is used.

Usage

previewBackfillSupport(
  ped,
  dates = NULL,
  from = NULL,
  to = NULL,
  by = "year",
  minAnimals = 2L
)

Arguments

ped

A quality-controlled pedigree data.frame (see qcStudbook) holding at least id, sire, dam, sex, gen, birth and exit (the last two as Date columns), and a status column when the studbook has one. Pass the full pedigree, not one already trimmed to a focal list of animals.

dates

The dates to count: Date values or ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) strings, at least one, with no missing or duplicated value. Leave it out (NULL) to use the series described by from, to and by; it cannot be combined with them.

from

The first date of the series: a Date or an ISO-8601 string. The default is the first 1 January with at least minAnimals living animals.

to

The last date of the series, as from. The default is the last 1 January on or before the latest birth or exit date in ped.

by

The step of the series: a string for seq.Date, such as "year" (the default), "6 months" or "quarter".

minAnimals

Single whole number, at least 2: the fewest living animals a 1 January needs to start the default series. Default 2.

Value

A data.frame with one row for each date, in date order, and the columns of the support table of backfillColonySnapshots: snapshotDate, nLiving (the animals counted), nPlacedByOffspring (of those, the ones with no birth date), nPossiblyAlive (animals with no birth date that are not counted and had not left), pctSireKnown and pctDamKnown (the percentage of the living animals whose sire or dam is recorded, that is neither blank nor a generated stand-in; NA when nobody was alive).

Details

The dates are laid out exactly as backfillColonySnapshots lays them out: give dates, or leave it out for a series of by steps (one year by default) from from to to. Unless you give them, the series starts at the first 1 January with at least minAnimals living animals and ends at the last 1 January on or before the latest birth or exit date in the pedigree. minAnimals only moves that default start: a date you name, in dates or as from, is never refused for having few animals.

An animal is counted on a date by the rules of backfillColonySnapshots: alive from its birth date, or, with no birth date, from the birth of its first offspring that has a date, until its exit date; an animal with no exit date counts only when the studbook lists it as living. No threshold refuses a date; read the counts beside the trend.

See also

backfillColonySnapshots

Examples

ped <- nprcgenekeepr::qcPed
previewBackfillSupport(ped,
  dates = as.Date(c("2005-01-01", "2010-01-01"))
)
#>   snapshotDate nLiving nPlacedByOffspring nPossiblyAlive pctSireKnown
#> 1   2005-01-01      86                  0              0     56.97674
#> 2   2010-01-01      63                  0              0     68.25397
#>   pctDamKnown
#> 1    89.53488
#> 2    90.47619

## the default series, and a later start when the early years rest on little
head(previewBackfillSupport(ped), 3L)
#>   snapshotDate nLiving nPlacedByOffspring nPossiblyAlive pctSireKnown
#> 1   1961-01-01       2                  0              2            0
#> 2   1962-01-01       3                  0              2            0
#> 3   1963-01-01       3                  0              2            0
#>   pctDamKnown
#> 1           0
#> 2           0
#> 3           0
head(previewBackfillSupport(ped, minAnimals = 30L), 3L)
#>   snapshotDate nLiving nPlacedByOffspring nPossiblyAlive pctSireKnown
#> 1   1970-01-01      39                  0              2     2.564103
#> 2   1971-01-01      52                  0              2     1.923077
#> 3   1972-01-01      54                  0              2     1.851852
#>   pctDamKnown
#> 1    2.564103
#> 2    1.923077
#> 3    1.851852
